summary: When upgrading Event-Driven Ansible 2.5 to 2.6, non-SSO users must reset their password, and the Automation Decisions Administrator role is removed so its permissions must be reassigned manually.
questions: Why do EDA users need to reset passwords after upgrade?
What happens to the Automation Decisions Administrator role in 2.6?
Do EDA SSO users need a new password after upgrading?

answer_card.title: EDA 2.5 → 2.6 upgrade
answer_card.answer_md:
- Non-SSO EDA users must **reset their password**; usernames are kept.
- SSO users don't reset passwords; permissions move with the SSO migration.
- **Automation Decisions Administrator** role is removed; reassign permissions manually.
